# Command reference

<!-- Generated by tools/build_command_reference.py from the application's menus
     and minflux_viewer/ui/common/command_meta.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every built-in menu command, in menu order, with its default keyboard shortcut
(change shortcuts in *Edit › Preferences › Shortcuts*). Any command can also be
found by typing a few letters of its name, menu or purpose in the search field
at the right of the toolbar, or in *Help › Command Finder*.

Plugins installed by the user are not listed here; see the
[scripting and plugin API](../scripting-api.md).

## File

### Open

*File › Open* · shortcut **Ctrl+O**

Open a MINFLUX/localization dataset.

### Close Dataset

*File › Close Dataset* · shortcut **Ctrl+W**

Close the active dataset and its windows.

### Close All Datasets

*File › Close All Datasets* · shortcut **Shift+W**

Close all datasets and their windows.

### Close All Windows

*File › Close All Windows* · shortcut **Ctrl+Shift+W**

Close all datasets and every plugin/analysis dialog, keeping only the Log and Console.

### Save

*File › Save* · shortcut **Ctrl+S**

Save the active dataset as a MINFLUX Viewer Zarr v2 store (the format is fixed; the dialog asks only where).

### Viewer format (.zarr)

*File › Save As › Viewer format (.zarr)*

Save raw canonical MINFLUX data as a Zarr v2 directory.

### MINFLUX data formats (.mat; .npy; .json)

*File › Save As › MINFLUX data formats (.mat; .npy; .json)*

Save raw canonical MINFLUX data as .mat, .npy, or .json.

### Custom table (.csv)

*File › Save As › Custom table (.csv)*

Export chosen attributes as a custom CSV table for another tool (the all-iteration canonical table is written by the MSR reader and by Save / export data > More options).

### Imspector file (.msr)

*File › Save As › Imspector file (.msr)*

Save raw canonical MINFLUX data as an experimental .msr file.

### Viewer metadata only (.json)

*File › Save As › Viewer metadata only (.json)*

Write only the processing metadata (Z scaling factor, transform, filters, ROIs, acquisition time) as a JSON file.

### Quit

*File › Quit* · shortcut **Ctrl+Q**

Quit the application.

## Edit

### Dataset Manager

*Edit › Dataset Manager* · shortcut **Ctrl+D**

Open the Dataset Manager (list / activate / organize datasets).

### Duplicate

*Edit › Duplicate* · shortcut **Shift+D**

Duplicate / crop the dataset (optionally to an ROI).

### Preferences

*Edit › Preferences* · shortcut **Shift+P**

Application preferences.

## View

### Show Info

*View › Show Info* · shortcut **Ctrl+I**

Show the Dataset Information window.

### Attribute Plot

*View › Attribute Plot* · shortcut **Ctrl+1**

Attribute plot (color localizations by an attribute). The 2-D renderer is chosen automatically: GPU for round markers when OpenGL is available, otherwise exact bulk painting or a screen-space count/mean aggregation for dense views.

### Attribute Histogram

*View › Attribute Histogram* · shortcut **Ctrl+2**

Attribute histogram.

### Loc Scatter Plot

*View › Loc Scatter Plot* · shortcut **Ctrl+3**

Localization scatter plot.

### Render

*View › Render* · shortcut **Ctrl+R**

Rendered localization image (right-click › View › Render Method selects the reconstruction method).

### Tracking View

*View › Tracking View* · shortcut **Ctrl+T**

Play localization trajectories as comets with fading tails over a de-emphasised structure backdrop.

### Log (Events)

*View › Log (Events)* · shortcut **Ctrl+L**

Event log window.

## Process

### Filter

*Process › Filter* · shortcut **Shift+F**

Filter localizations by attribute ranges; Auto adds data-derived bounds from the Preferences › Process › Filter rules.

### Combine

*Process › Channel › Combine*

Combine datasets into a multi-channel overlay.

### Split

*Process › Channel › Split*

Split an overlay back into per-channel datasets.

### Flatten

*Process › Channel › Flatten*

Flatten a multi-channel overlay into one non-overlay dataset (transforms baked, trace ids remapped) for combined analysis.

Inputs: active multi-channel overlay.

Outputs: single flattened dataset (hot LUT).

### by DCR: detection channel ratio

*Process › Channel › Convert Dataset to Multi-Channel Overlay › by DCR: detection channel ratio*

Separate colors by the DCR distribution: value-window channels from a mixture fit, detected peaks or even placement, plus channels from a ROI or a filter row; assignment is per localization.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n_components` | 2 |  | mixture components |

Inputs: active dataset with dcr.

Outputs: per-channel (+unassigned) overlay datasets.

### by Time Window

*Process › Channel › Convert Dataset to Multi-Channel Overlay › by Time Window*

Separate the active dataset into an overlay of filtered acquisition-time channels.

Inputs: active dataset with tim.

Outputs: time-window overlay datasets.

### by MINFLUX data attribute

*Process › Channel › Convert Dataset to Multi-Channel Overlay › by MINFLUX data attribute*

Convert a dataset to a multi-channel overlay by any MINFLUX attribute's distribution (mixture fit, detected peaks or even placement), or from a ROI or a filter row.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n_components` | 2 |  | mixture components |

Inputs: active MINFLUX dataset.

Outputs: per-channel (+unassigned) overlay datasets.

### Revert Overlay to Original Dataset

*Process › Channel › Convert Dataset to Multi-Channel Overlay › Revert Overlay to Original Dataset*

Revert a separation overlay back to its single original dataset (removes the channels; reconstructs if the source was closed).

Inputs: active separation overlay.

Outputs: original single dataset.

### ROI Manager

*Process › ROI › ROI Manager*

ROI Manager (add/edit/convert/save ROIs).

### Convert

*Process › ROI › Convert › …*

Convert an ROI to another type.

Variants: *to Bounding Box*, *to Rectangle*, *to Oval*, *to Ellipse*, *Line to Region*, *Region to Line*, *to Point*.

### Fit

*Process › ROI › Fit › …*

Fit a shape to the localizations a region ROI highlights (or spline-fit / interpolate its outline).

Variants: *Fit Rectangle*, *Fit Circle*, *Fit Ellipse*, *Fit Polygon*, *Fit Convex Hull*, *Fit Spline*, *Interpolate*.

### Enlarge / Shrink

*Process › ROI › Enlarge / Shrink*

Enlarge / shrink an ROI.

### Skeletonize

*Process › ROI › Skeletonize*

Skeletonize a region ROI to its centreline.

### Convex Hull

*Process › ROI › Convex Hull*

Convex hull of a polygon/freehand ROI.

### Add Cross-Section

*Process › ROI › Add Cross-Section*

Add the drawn polygon to a legacy contour-stack polyhedron at another Z, so the shape between levels is interpolated rather than extruded.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | 0.0 | nm | stacking coordinate of the new cross-section |

Inputs: selected polyhedron ROI; a drawn polygon.

Outputs: multi-slice polyhedron ROI.

### Restore ROI

*Process › ROI › Restore ROI*

Restore the active ROI onto another view (render ↔ scatter), or bring back the last active ROI after an accidental delete.

### Aggregate Localizations

*Process › Aggregate Localizations*

Aggregate valid final MINFLUX localizations per trace using a photon threshold and photon-weighted spatial centroids.

Inputs: active MINFLUX dataset.

Outputs: aggregated dataset.

Shown in the menu but not available in this version: *Process › Channel › Channel Tool*, *Process › Batch Processing › Batch Render*, *Process › Batch Processing › Batch Export*, *Process › Batch Processing › Batch Filter*.

## Analyze

### Scale Bar

*Analyze › Measure › Scale Bar*

Add a draggable scale bar to a 2-D view.

### Plot Profile

*Analyze › Measure › Plot Profile*

Plot the localization-density profile along a line/polyline/freehand-line ROI in a render or scatter view (live, ImageJ-style, tunable width).

### Set Measurements

*Analyze › Set Measurements*

Configure which measurements are reported.

### CRLB (Cramer-Rao Lower Bound)

*Analyze › Loc Precision / Resolution › CRLB (Cramer-Rao Lower Bound)*

MINFLUX Cramér-Rao bound of the targeted-donut model from the measured photon counts and background. Refs: Balzarotti 2017, Marin & Ries 2024.

Inputs: active dataset (eco, efo, fbg).

Outputs: CRLB precision (nm).

### StdDev per Trace

*Analyze › Loc Precision / Resolution › StdDev per Trace*

Localization precision as the per-trace standard deviation (traces with at least 5 localizations; raw z). Ref: Ostersehlt 2022.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_locs` | 5 |  | min localizations per trace |

Inputs: active dataset (loc, tid).

Outputs: per-trace σ (x,y,z) nm; median σ.

### FRC Resolution Estimation

*Analyze › Loc Precision / Resolution › FRC Resolution Estimation*

Image resolution by Fourier ring correlation (1/7 threshold), for the whole acquisition or as it develops over acquisition time. Refs: Banterle 2013, Nieuwenhuizen 2013.

Inputs: active dataset (loc; tim for the time course).

Outputs: FRC resolution (nm); resolution vs acquisition time.

### Local Density

*Analyze › Local Density*

Local density per localization (neighbour count within a radius; centre included).

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radius_nm` | 100.0 | nm | neighbourhood radius |
| `dimensions` | 2 |  | 2 or 3 |
| `method` | kdtree |  | kdtree \| voxel_histogram \| voxel_radius |

Inputs: active dataset (loc).

Outputs: den attribute (per loc).

### Estimate Average Trace Size

*Analyze › Trace › Estimate Average Trace Size*

Estimate the average per-trace size (log-distance Gaussian fit).

Inputs: active dataset (raw loc, tid).

Outputs: trace size (nm).

### Estimate Z Scaling Factor

*Analyze › Trace › Estimate Z Scaling Factor*

Estimate the Z scaling factor from raw last-valid trace sizes.

Inputs: active dataset (raw loc, tid).

Outputs: Z scaling factor.

### Convolution

*Analyze › Segmentation › Convolution*

Geometry-kernel matched-filter detection (ring/disk/gaussian/LoG) → rectangle ROIs.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `geometry` | ring |  | ring\|disk\|gaussian\|log |
| `pixel_nm` | 5.0 | nm | render pixel |
| `min_response` | 0.5 |  | matched-filter response threshold |
| `separation_nm` | 0.0 | nm | min peak separation (NMS) |
| `min_support` | 0.0 |  | ring support threshold (0 = off) |

Inputs: active dataset (loc).

Outputs: detection rectangle ROIs.

### Shape Model

*Analyze › Segmentation › Shape Model*

Fit objects of a known geometry (capsule/curved capsule/ellipse/rectangle/disk) to the XY density → editable polygon contour ROIs; separates touching objects and flags ones clipped by the acquisition frame.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | capsule |  | capsule\|arc_capsule\|ellipse\|rectangle\|disk |
| `length_nm` | (1400.0, 4000.0) | nm | expected object length |
| `width_nm` | (600.0, 1200.0) | nm | expected object width |
| `pixel_nm` | 20.0 | nm | detection pixel |
| `instance_cost` | 0.25 |  | price of one extra object, in object areas |
| `vertices` | 48 |  | polygon contour vertices |

Inputs: active dataset (loc); acquisition ROI from the source .msr (optional).

Outputs: polygon contour ROIs.

### Curvilinear Structures

*Analyze › Segmentation › Curvilinear Structures*

Detect curvilinear structures.

### Straightened Volume along Skeleton

*Analyze › Segmentation › Straightened Volume along Skeleton*

Straighten a volume along a skeleton/line.

### Particle Average

*Analyze › Segmentation › Particle Average*

Particle averaging (template-free / template / NPC model fit) of collected particles.

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | free |  | free \| template \| geomfit |
| `box_nm` | 150.0 | nm | average box |
| `pixel_nm` | 3.0 | nm | alignment pixel |
| `n_angles` | 36 |  | rotation search steps |
| `correct_tilt` | False |  | PCA axial-tilt correction |

Inputs: collected particles.

Outputs: averaged super-particle dataset.

### MSD Analysis

*Analyze › Tracking › MSD Analysis*

Trajectory workbench, computed in the background: mean squared displacement per uninterrupted segment (irregular time steps), step and turning-angle statistics, confinement and ergodicity diagnostics; accepted results can be added as attributes or exported.

Shown in the menu but not available in this version: *Analyze › Clustering › DBSCAN*, *Analyze › Clustering › K Nearest Neighbour*.

## Plugins

### 3D Convolution

*Plugins › 3D Convolution*

Region-focused XYZ matched filtering of the active 3D dataset. Separate from the 2D convolution tool (Analyze › Segmentation).

### Data Simulator

*Plugins › Data Simulator*

Generate synthetic MINFLUX-like sample datasets (NPC / microtubule / sphere / … ) and manage the File › Open Sample Data presets.

### Drift Correction

*Plugins › Drift Correction*

Correct drift with the fiducial beads (as Imspector) and/or by time-window cross-correlation of the localizations (2D/3D).

### Generate Method Text

*Plugins › Generate Method Text*

Compile a Methods paragraph from selected Log events.

### Macro Recorder

*Plugins › Macro Recorder*

Record viewer actions as a reusable mfv Python script.

### MSR Reader

*Plugins › MSR Reader*

Parse, preview, and export Abberior Imspector .msr files.

### ParaView

*Plugins › ParaView*

Export active dataset as .vtp and open it in ParaView.

### Script Editor

*Plugins › Script Editor*

Open a Python script editor bound to the current MINFLUX Viewer session.

### Spatial Pattern Analysis along Line Profile

*Plugins › Spatial Pattern Analysis along Line Profile*

Straighten a directed line ROI and analyze longitudinal repetition, signed side profiles, transverse displacement, FFT and autocorrelation.

### Trace Viewer

*Plugins › Trace Viewer*

Inspect individual molecule traces: per-trace table, time-series, animated head/tail, tile/overlay views, tail removal and export.
